📌 Tehran, IRNA - Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian congratulated the national women’s para taekwondo team on their world championship win in South Korea.

​
He expressed pride in all the team’s hardworking members and wished them continued success.
​
Iran made history at the 2026 World Para Taekwondo Championships, topping the women’s team standings for the first time after Maryam Abdollahpour and Aylar Jami won gold and Zahra Rahimi claimed silver.
​
The team’s success was complemented by individual accolades, with Atefeh Keshavarz named Best Coach and Abdollahpour earning Best Female Athlete honors.
​
The championships were held in Muju, South Korea, from November 20 to 22.

The November 2026 midterm elections have exposed a fundamental contradiction at the heart of Trump's second presidency: he still occupies the White House, but the political coalition that once gave him broad control of Washington has suffered a major defeat.

Democrats captured both chambers of Congress, making significant gains even in traditionally Republican territory. Voter frustration over the cost of living, the war with Iran and concerns about the administration's priorities helped produce one of the most consequential midterm reversals in recent American politics.

The new Democratic majority will have powerful tools at its disposal, including congressional investigations, budget negotiations and the ability to block presidential legislation and nominations. 

Trump, however, retains executive authority and the presidential veto.
This creates a dangerous political equilibrium.

Democrats can obstruct the administration, but they cannot easily replace its agenda with their own. Trump can continue governing, but increasingly without the legislative support required to turn his political promises into lasting policy.

There is a deeper paradox here: the midterms may have weakened Trump's control of Washington without weakening his influence over the Republican Party.

The real question is whether Democrats can turn opposition into an alternative vision of government. If they fail, Trump may lose control of Congress yet remain the most powerful political force in America.

Another major aviation technology disruption to add to our growing Cyber Disruption Watch.

Delta Air Lines experienced a computer-system failure Sunday morning, triggering an FAA ground stop for Delta flights at Atlanta’s Hartsfield-Jackson International Airport.

🔴 WHAT WE KNOW:
▪️ The outage affected Delta’s automated aircraft weight-and-balance system, essential for calculating safe aircraft loading.

▪️ More than 1,000 Delta flights were reportedly delayed nationwide.

▪️ Delta was forced to perform calculations manually while technicians worked to restore the system.

▪️ The Atlanta ground stop was lifted around 8:40 a.m. ET, although delays continued.

▪️ The underlying cause has not been publicly established.
